text:
```yaml
name: Auto‑approve Copilot PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'copilot')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Auto‑approve Copilot PR
        uses: stefanprodan/auto-approve-action@v1
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
